mainEntity.name: What is crypto exchange listing PR and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exchange listing PR is the coordinated media, KOL and community campaign that runs around a token listing on a centralised exchange such as Binance, OKX or Bybit. It covers the embargo strategy with tier-1 outlets, exchange-native content placements, KOL activation and compliance-approved messaging. It is for projects that have a confirmed listing date and want the announcement to drive real trading volume and lasting press coverage, not just a single wire blast.

mainEntity.name: How much does exchange listing PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A focused listing sprint covering embargo prep, tier-1 outreach, KOL activation and exchange-native content typically runs $15K–$40K for the four to eight week campaign window. An ongoing fractional retainer that includes listing support alongside sustained coverage runs $5K–$12K per month. Full-service agencies charge $15K–$45K per month for comparable scope. KOL costs sit on top: nano influencers $200–$1.5K per post, micro $500–$5K, mid-tier $10K–$30K, macro $25K–$100K or more.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets and channels do you target for a listing announcement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto editorial: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks. Exchange-native: Binance Square, OKX Learn, Bybit Blog. Regional: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CoinPost (Japan), ChainCatcher (China), Inc42 (India). Mainstream where the token has a genuine crossover story: Forbes, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. KOL amplification across X, YouTube and Telegram, scoped to the trading community most relevant to the token's vertical.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance do I need to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ideally six to eight weeks before the listing date. That window allows for embargo briefings with tier-1 journalists, KOL contracting and briefing, exchange-native content drafting and compliance review. Projects that come in two weeks out can still run a trimmed campaign, but the editorial embargo option is typically off the table at that point. The earlier the brief, the more leverage you have over the narrative.
